description: Generate a flexible round-trip price calendar for a fixed-length stay around a chosen travel window. Returns (depart date, return date, lowest total price) entries for nearby date pairs that preserve the original trip length; intended for price discovery, not exact itinerary selection.

currency.description: Currency to show prices in (ISO 4217, default: USD). Pass the user's local currency when you know it, e.g. GBP for a UK user or EUR for a user in Germany. Prices are converted from USD and are approximate; sorting and booking links are unaffected.

destination.description: Arrival city name or IATA code (will be resolved to IATA code automatically)

origin.description: Departure city name or IATA code (will be resolved to IATA code automatically)

returnDate.description: Return date for the reference trip (YYYY-MM-DD format)

sort.description: Sort results chronologically or by lowest price first

name: sk_flex_return_calendar

id.description: Fare chart identifier; not a user identifier

usdPrice.description: Source price in US dollars; use it for comparison

destination.description: Resolved destination airport code used for this search

mode.description: Indicates whether these options vary departure dates or return dates

origin.description: Resolved origin airport code used for this search

approximate.description: True when prices were converted from USD; the final charge on the booking site may differ

currency.description: ISO 4217 code the prices are shown in

notice.description: Short note to relay to the user about the shown currency

rate.description: Units of `currency` per 1 USD used for conversion (1 for USD)

rateAsOf.description: When the server fetched the exchange rate (ISO datetime)

requestedCurrency.description: ISO 4217 code the caller asked for (may differ on fallback)

searchUrl.description: Complete search URL with all parameters

sort.description: Ordering applied to the options array

title: Skiplagged Round-Trip Price Calendar
